name: Tsunoda Miyabi
source:
Miyabi is a distant girl who stays away from the crowds and likes to be alone.

However, she occasionally goes out with [url=https://vndb.org/c21995]Saki[/url] but does not participate in her group activities.

When she hears that [url=https://vndb.org/c69534]Yuuki[/url] wants to run away from the school, she starts becoming interested in him and wants to talk more often with him, to the greatest surprise (and jealousy) of her classmates.

[spoiler]Miyabi is interested in Yuuki because she too is looking for a way to get out of school to ask her parents for a very important favor in relation to her future career path, becoming a pâtissière.

In her route, Miyabi and Yuuki exchange their "rings" to make others think they are going out together and also avoid attract the professors' suspicion since they need to spend a lot of time together planning their escape.[/spoiler]
